before.content:
tasks.register<Exec>("verifyFixtures") {
    description = "Runs the TypeScript oracle and Java fixture runner comparison."
    dependsOn(
        ":ji-test-kit:runFixture",
        ":ji-test-kit:test",
    )
    val javaOutput = layout.buildDirectory.file("fixture/java-normalized.json")
    inputs.file("contracts/fixtures/minimal-session.json")
    inputs.file(javaOutput)
    commandLine("node", "scripts/verify-fixtures.mjs", "--java-output", javaOutput.get().asFile.absolutePath)
}

after.content:

    commandLine("node", "scripts/verify-fixtures.mjs", "--java-output", javaOutput.get().asFile.absolutePath)
}
